attributes.context: This appears in Section 6 of the MASTER LABOR AGREEMENT, following a sentence that prohibits rules, customs, or practices that limit production or increase the time required to do any work.

extraction_text: There shall be no limitation or restriction on the use of machinery, tools or other labor-saving devices supplied by the I/E, provided such equipment is operated in accordance with the jurisdictional awards of the Building and Construction Trades Department of the AFL-CIO, and approved by the Department of Industrial Relations of the State of California.

attributes.context: This appears in Appendix VII Detailing of a Master Labor Agreement and addresses on-site detailing work that may be done by hand or computer-aided methods.

extraction_text: On site Detailing, whether by hand or computer aided, shall continue to be performed only by employees referred from the DC#36 Local Unions individual Local Union Hiring Hall

attributes.context: The same Appendix VII Detailing section specifies that detailing work, whether hand or computer performed, includes spooling and accuracy checks for fabrication.

extraction_text: Detailing regardless of where performed: 1. Whether by hand or computer shall include spooling of all plumbing and piping which is to be fabricated including but not limited to a final check for accuracy of a root drawing as required for fabrication.

attributes.context: Within Appendix VII Detailing, this sets a limited assignment right for an outside UA detailer when the work is limited to computer detailing.

extraction_text: One (1) UA detailer from outside the following UA locals (62,228,246,442) may be assigned per job as a company representative and paid as such. Note: This company representative does not count towards the allocation of manpower under DC#36 Freedom of Movement of Manpower as long as work performed is limited to computer detailing.

attributes.context: The surrounding Master Labor Agreement text addresses detailing work by hand or computer, CAD/Revit-related tasks, and assignment of specific tasks to UA members or others, which contextualizes this clause as a job-assignment and tool-of-the-trade provision for robotic surveying equipment.

extraction_text: All work covered under this Agreement requiring the use of Robotic Total Station Systems including, but not limited to, Trimble Robotic Total Station, Sokkia Robotic Total Station and similar such devices, is a tool of the trade at the jobsite and will be field operated by a bargaining unit member. Note: It does not include downloading or programming to the device or digital scanning of existing conditions.
